_about: Blind eye judgments (Claude, Read tool on /data/harvest/logs/marr/eye_sheet_00..11.jpg, 2026-09-26 06:03-06:12 UTC) of 144 Molmo2-ER gripper pointings on S-E2E head frames, made BEFORE reading any filter decision. Codes: g = on the named arm's gripper (fingers or body), o = on the other arm's gripper, x = elsewhere (object, arm link away from the gripper, person, background) while the named gripper is visible, n = the named gripper not visible (or no point with the gripper not visible), u = on a gripper whose arm identity could not be decided from the image (added during judging; counted as an error in the conservative rate). Arm identity was read from the image side and the arm chain the gripper hangs from (robot left = image left). Many RB1 grippers show only fingertips at the bottom edge, so single judgments are uncertain (see the results doc).
